rival: Horizontal reflection takes priority when a zero component touches both a horizontal and a vertical edge; all other behavior is identical.
program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((transformed (cellmap g (r c v) (if (zero? v) 1 0)))
                  (holes-objs (objects transformed 0))
                  (holes (map obj-cells holes-objs))
                  (new-hole-set (make-hash))
                  (path-set (make-hash))
                  (_process (for ((hole holes))
                              (unless
                                (null? hole)
                                (let* ((rs (map first hole))
                                       (cs (map second hole))
                                       (r1 (min-list rs))
                                       (r2 (max-list rs))
                                       (c1 (min-list cs))
                                       (c2 (max-list cs))
                                       (touches-top (zero? r1))
                                       (touches-bot (= r2 (- h 1)))
                                       (touches-left (zero? c1))
                                       (touches-right (= c2 (- w 1)))
                                       (mirror (cond
                                                 ((or touches-top touches-bot) 'rows)
                                                 ((or touches-left touches-right) 'cols)
                                                 (else 'none))))
                                  (unless
                                    (eq? mirror 'none)
                                    (for ((cell hole))
                                      (let* ((cr (first cell))
                                             (cc (second cell))
                                             (nr (if (eq? mirror 'rows) (- h 1 cr) cr))
                                             (nc (if (eq? mirror 'rows) cc (- w 1 cc))))
                                        (hash-set! new-hole-set (list nr nc) #t)))
                                    (cond
                                      ((eq? mirror 'rows) (for* ((rr (range 0 h)) (cc cs))
                                              (hash-set! path-set (list rr cc) #t)))
                                      (else (for* ((rr rs) (cc (range 0 w)))
                                                  (hash-set! path-set (list rr cc) #t))))))))))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (cond
                        ((hash-has-key? new-hole-set (list r c)) 0)
                        ((hash-has-key? path-set (list r c)) 7)
                        (else v)))))))
